sources.name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — RCS portal
sources.verdict: Verified live (redirects to mjrcs-web-front app). Free per-entity search + filed-document download with account; LBR operates an open-data REST API covering RCS records and RESA publications; bulk datasets pushed to data.public.lu under CC0.

sources.name: data.public.lu — Luxembourg open data portal (RCS/company datasets)
sources.verdict: Verified live; ~3,000 datasets with an API reference. Dataset listing is JS-rendered so exact RCS bulk datasets not confirmed in this pass — recommended route for bulk register mirroring per multiple secondary sources.

sources.name: RESA — Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (company gazette)
sources.verdict: RESA is the legal gazette for company publications (incorporations, changes, liquidations), served via the LBR portal and covered by the LBR open-data API. Portal verified live; dedicated RESA deep-link not separately verified.

sources.name: RBE — Register of Beneficial Owners
sources.verdict: Exists under LBR but public access is restricted post-CJEU (legitimate-interest regime). Catalogued for completeness only — project rule: never assume open UBO data.

sources.name: CSSF Search Entities (supervised entities database)
sources.verdict: Verified live (searchentities.apps.cssf.lu 302→edesk.apps.cssf.lu; SPA shell only via plain fetch). Covers banks, PFS, IFMs/AIFMs, UCIs, VASPs/CASPs by category; CSSF documentation states data downloadable as PDF/CSV in-app.

sources.name: CSSF bulk XLSX lists (e.g. AIFs under management quarterly list)
sources.verdict: Direct XLSX URL surfaced in search results — CSSF publishes flat-file lists under /wp-content/uploads/ (AIF quarterly list, UCI lists, banks/PFS lists). Matches the project's already-harvested CSSF bulk-file route. File itself not downloaded in this pass.

sources.name: CSSF Publication & Data library (official lists: banks, PFS, IFMs, UCIs, depositaries, administrators)
sources.verdict: Verified via search (2,853 results in library). Filterable document library including 'Lists' document type — the index for hunting fund-administrator, depositary and PFS lists. Note /en/document-type/list/ guess returned 404; filter within the library instead.

sources.name: CSSF crypto-assets / VASP-CASP register pages
sources.verdict: Verified page exists. VASP list and MiCA CASP/EMT/ART supervised entities are exposed through the Search Entities app (JS); MiCA transition ended 1 July 2026 so CASP list is now the operative register. EU-wide cross-check via ESMA register.

sources.name: CSSF public register of approved audit firms (réviseurs d'entreprises agréés)
sources.verdict: CSSF is audit oversight authority and maintains the public REA/audit-firm register (confirmed via Guichet.lu and IRE secondary sources); exact register URL not pinned down in this pass — locate via the publication library.

sources.name: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) — registers and statistics
sources.verdict: Verified live. Publishes official registers (designated payment/settlement systems, third-country systems), MFI/credit-institution reporting populations, and extensive statistics; RSS feed present in site structure.

sources.name: CAA — Commissariat aux Assurances operator lists
sources.verdict: Verified via search: caa.lu serves per-category operator lists as plain pages (life/non-life insurers, reinsurers, PSA, brokers/agents/agencies with ?l= pagination, domiciliaries). The reinsurance-captive and PSA lists are directly relevant to alt-fund service graph and ILS.

sources.name: CAA pension funds list (CAA-supervised pension vehicles)
sources.verdict: CAA supervises certain pension funds (verified in CAA's own scope statement); CSSF supervises SEPCAV/ASSEP separately (in CSSF lists). Together these are the LP-side registers for Luxembourg.

sources.name: Administration de l'environnement — Luxembourg EU ETS registry (Union Registry national accounts)
sources.verdict: Verified via search: Administration de l'environnement is the national administrator of the Luxembourg part of the Union Registry; pages cover ETS1/ETS2 and account opening. Account-holder data itself sits in the EU Union Registry / EUTL.

sources.name: ESMA registers (CASPs, AIFMD passporting, MiFID firms — LU filter)
sources.verdict: Not re-verified this pass but well-established open register with machine-readable access; CSSF itself points consumers to the ESMA register for CASP verification. Useful LU cross-check and passporting view.

sources.name: ECB Banking Supervision — list of supervised entities (LU banks)
sources.verdict: Known-good ECB list (significant + less significant institutions, XLSX/PDF), referenced by CSSF publications; covers Luxembourg banking groups including depositary banks. URL not re-fetched this pass.

sources.name: Legilux — Journal officiel du Grand-Duché (Mémorial A/B)
sources.verdict: Verified live (minimal server-rendered shell). Official legislation gazette with ELI-structured URIs; company publications moved to RESA in 2016, so Legilux matters for laws/regulatory instruments rather than entity events.

sources.name: Justice.public.lu — courts portal (insolvency/faillites information)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass. Bankruptcy judgments are legally published via RESA and the court registry; the justice portal documents procedure and curator appointments. Use RESA as the machine route for insolvency events.

sources.name: Portail des marchés publics (PMP)
sources.verdict: Verified live via search (individual consultation pages resolve). Central e-procurement portal for tender notices and e-submission; interactive app, no obvious bulk export — above-threshold notices mirrored on TED.

sources.name: marches.public.lu — public procurement information portal
sources.verdict: Verified in search results as the state's procurement information site accompanying PMP. Not fetched directly.

sources.name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (Luxembourg notices)
sources.verdict: EU-level with documented public API and bulk XML; the reliable machine route for LU above-threshold procurement. Not re-verified this pass (well-known).

sources.name: Luxembourg Stock Exchange (LuxSE) — securities and issuer search, official list
sources.verdict: Verified live. ISIN/issuer search, official list access, new listings, market data; ~40k listed securities incl. the world's largest bond-listing venue — key for fund/SPV/CLO issuance discovery. Heavier data likely behind JS or paid services.

sources.name: LGX — Luxembourg Green Exchange (sustainable securities display)
sources.verdict: LGX section confirmed prominent on verified luxse.com homepage; this deep URL not individually fetched. Green/social/sustainability bond issuer universe — relevant to energy-transition and ESG alts.

sources.name: LPEA — Luxembourg Private Equity & Venture Capital Association members list
sources.verdict: Verified live and public: searchable directory with membership type, organisation type, investment focus and industry focus fields — rendered by a JS smart-search component (shortcode lpea_member_smart_search), so needs headless or endpoint discovery. Note /members/ path is password-protected; use /membership/members-list/.

sources.name: ALFI — Association of the Luxembourg Fund Industry
sources.verdict: Fetch attempt failed (connection refused from this environment) — could not verify the membership directory URL. ALFI is real and central (fund industry association); retry from another network.

sources.name: ABBL — Luxembourg Bankers' Association
sources.verdict: Site verified live (professional pages resolve) but my guessed members-directory URL (/en/members/) returned 404 — public member list location unconfirmed.

sources.name: ACA — Association des Compagnies d'Assurances et de Réassurances
sources.verdict: Verified live pages; 146 members stated. Full public member directory not confirmed — CAA regulator lists are the more complete machine route for the insurance population.

sources.name: Luxembourg for Finance — financial centre agency
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; well-established public-private financial-centre development agency (House of Finance, alongside ABBL/ALFI/ACA per verified ACA pages). Sector reports and ecosystem mapping.

sources.name: LHoFT — Luxembourg House of Financial Technology
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass. Fintech hub with resident/member startup listings — useful for tokenized-RWA and fund-tech entity discovery.

sources.name: Luxinnovation — national innovation agency
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; real national agency, operates startup ecosystem mapping with Dealroom (see Startup Luxembourg).

sources.name: Startup Luxembourg — national startup database (Dealroom-powered)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; known Luxinnovation/Dealroom ecosystem database of LU startups — JS app. Market-map use only where Dealroom ToS applies to embedded data.

sources.name: SNCI — Société Nationale de Crédit et d'Investissement
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; Luxembourg's national development bank (loans, equity participations) — annual reports disclose participations. Real institution, URL standard.

sources.name: Chambre de Commerce Luxembourg
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; mandatory-membership chamber, economic publications and company services. Not a register substitute (use LBR).

sources.name: Barreau de Luxembourg — annuaire des avocats
sources.verdict: Verified via search: public directory of ~713 law firms/études with contacts. Insolvency curators are drawn from the bar — relevant to distressed/NPL service graph. Respect the no-personal-data-at-scale rule: firm-level only.

sources.name: IRE — Institut des Réviseurs d'Entreprises
sources.verdict: Real professional institute of approved statutory auditors (REA); confirmed via Guichet.lu secondary sources. Member roll location not verified — CSSF's public audit register is the authoritative list.

sources.name: OEC — Ordre des Experts-Comptables
sources.verdict: Real chartered-accountants order with a public register (confirmed via secondary source ilicompta.lu); directory URL not verified this pass. Relevant to fund-administration service graph.

sources.name: RICS — regulated firms directory (Luxembourg filter)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; RICS's find-a-firm service is the standard public route to accredited valuers operating in LU real estate. Verify LU filtering before adapter work.

sources.name: FDC — Fonds de Compensation (sovereign pension reserve fund)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; real state pension reserve fund (~€27bn class), publishes annual reports with external-manager mandates — a genuine LP-side signal source.

sources.name: STATEC — national statistics institute
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; official statistics office with open datasets (business demography, finance sector) also mirrored on data.public.lu. Context/denominator data, not entity records.

sources.name: EIB — European Investment Bank (HQ Luxembourg) project & data portal
sources.verdict: Not re-verified this pass; EIB is headquartered in Luxembourg and publishes a public financed-projects database and open-data portal — DFI/LP-side signals for European infra and credit.

sources.name: EIF — European Investment Fund equity & guarantee mandates
sources.verdict: Not re-verified this pass; EIF (Luxembourg-based) discloses fund commitments and intermediaries lists publicly — one of the best open LP-side sources for European PE/VC fund discovery.

sources.name: Paperjam — business daily (Maison Moderne)
sources.verdict: Site verified live; the leading LU business medium (FR). No working RSS found — /rss and /feed both 404; distribution is via newsletters. Headline+link ingest would need HTML parsing of section pages.

sources.name: Delano — English-language business news (Maison Moderne)
sources.verdict: Real and active (same publisher as Paperjam); /rss returned 404, no feed URL found. English-language finance/fund coverage of the LU centre.

sources.name: Luxembourg Times
sources.verdict: Fetch blocked from this environment (unable to fetch); real English daily (Mediahuis Luxembourg). RSS availability unconfirmed; partial paywall expected.

sources.name: Luxemburger Wort
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; the largest LU daily (DE/FR, Mediahuis). Paywalled; feed status unverified. Business desk covers finance centre and insolvencies.

sources.name: Tageblatt
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; real second daily (Editpress). Feed status unverified.

sources.name: RTL Today / RTL.lu
sources.verdict: Fetch blocked from this environment; RTL is the dominant broadcaster with English (Today) and Luxembourgish news. RSS endpoint unconfirmed.

sources.name: Chronicle.lu
sources.verdict: Verified live: English news portal with business/finance sections; server-rendered and parseable, but no RSS feed visible (daily eNewsletter instead).

sources.name: Silicon Luxembourg — startup & tech media
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING RSS (RSS 2.0, items current to Aug 2026). Best open feed for LU startup/VC/space/fintech signals.

sources.name: Investment Officer Luxembourg — fund industry media
sources.verdict: Real specialist fund-industry outlet (EN/FR); /en/rss.xml returned 404 so feed unconfirmed. High-signal coverage of ManCos, AIFMs, private markets in LU.

sources.name: AGEFI Luxembourg — financial monthly
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; long-standing LU financial publication (FR/EN). Feed status unverified.

sources.name: Reporter.lu — investigative journalism
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; real subscription investigative outlet, occasionally deep finance/fund exposés. Paywalled — headline+link only.

sources.name: Lëtzebuerger Journal
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; real digital-first outlet. Lower finance density than Paperjam/Delano.

sources.name: CSSF news & communiqués
sources.verdict: Verified live: communiqués, press releases (incl. entity dissolutions/withdrawals — direct alt-signals), circulars, FAQs, statistics; page links 'Subscribe to the RSS feed' at /en/rss-feed/ (subscription page — resolve the concrete feed URL there).

sources.name: BCL press & statistical releases
sources.verdict: BCL homepage verified with press/statistical release sections and an RSS icon referencing support/rss/00_rssfeed.rss; this deep press URL itself not individually fetched.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance press (mfin.gouvernement.lu)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; standard gouvernement.lu ministry subsite with press releases on financial-centre policy. gouvernement.lu sites historically expose RSS — verify per-site.

sources.name: Gouvernement.lu — government news portal
sources.verdict: Not fetched this pass; central government news/press portal covering all ministries (economy, environment/ETS, justice). Feed status unverified.

sources.name: LuxSE press centre & 'Beyond the bell'
sources.verdict: Verified on live luxse.com: dedicated press centre plus blog; listings/new-issuance announcements are direct signals for fund/SPV/bond activity. A LuxSE RSS feed historically existed (announced via Paperjam) — current feed URL unconfirmed.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deep coverage of Luxembourg as Europe's #1 fund domicile: AIFs, RAIFs, SIFs, SCSp structures, AIFM/ManCo mapping, LP commitments into LU vehicles. Weak on the local service-provider graph below top-tier admins.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CSSF official lists and bulk XLSX files (AIFM/UCI/AIF lists), LBR/RCS filings and RESA publications, LuxSE prospectuses and official list, ALFI/LPEA reports and statistics — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on PE/VC deals and funds whose vehicles sit in Luxembourg (SCSp/SCA fund entities, holdcos); good GP/LP linkage. LU-specific entity depth is filings-driven and patchy for smaller structures.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: RCS/RESA incorporation and capital-change filings, LuxSE bond/fund listings, press (Paperjam, Delano, wire services), fund-manager websites.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Powers the official national startup database (Startup Luxembourg with Luxinnovation), so LU startup/VC coverage is unusually good for a small market; thin on funds, credit, real assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Luxinnovation ecosystem data, startup self-reporting, Silicon Luxembourg and general press, registry cross-checks against RCS — the underlying public routes (Luxinnovation, press, RCS) are open to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Basic LU startup and funding-round coverage; self-reported and press-driven, weak entity resolution against RCS names; almost no fund/AIFM coverage.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, Silicon Luxembourg-type media, company self-submissions.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The Luxembourg Fund Report — the reference local dataset on fund service providers: market shares of fund administrators, custodians/depositaries, auditors, legal advisers, ManCos per fund. Exactly our category-6 service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Fund annual reports and prospectuses (filed via RCS/LuxSE), CSSF UCI/AIF lists, LuxSE official list — all public and directly harvestable by us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LU-based fund reference-data and reporting utilities; cover fund document/data dissemination for domiciled funds. Infrastructure providers more than intelligence competitors, but their existence shows the underlying data flows.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CSSF filings, fund prospectuses/KIDs, LuxSE official list — the official-list and CSSF routes are open.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Resell or guide access to LU company-register data; OpenCorporates lists the RCS as register #144. Coverage is raw register-grade with no alternatives-specific enrichment.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: LBR RCS portal and open-data API, RESA gazette, data.public.lu CC0 datasets — confirming our direct tier-1 route is viable.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but not found/confirmed: (1) working RSS feeds for Paperjam and Delano — /rss and /feed both 404; Maison Moderne appears to have moved distribution to newsletters; (2) a public ABBL member-directory URL — site live but /en/members/ 404; (3) ALFI membership directory — alfi.lu refused connections from this environment, unverified; (4) a single full-register RCS bulk dump — data.public.lu hosts RCS datasets and LBR has an open-data API, but the exact bulk dataset pages are JS-rendered and were not individually confirmed; (5) open UBO data — RBE access is restricted post-CJEU (expected, per project rule); (6) a confirmed current LuxSE RSS feed URL (one was announced historically); (7) Luxembourg Times and RTL feeds — both hosts blocked plain fetch; (8) any LU-specific litigation-funding, royalty, or private-carbon registry — none exists; carbon route is the EU Union Registry/EUTL with Administration de l'environnement as national administrator; (9) CSSF /en/document-type/list/ and /en/supervised-entities/ guessed URLs — 404; correct routes are the Publication & Data library and the edesk Search Entities SPA.
